items.title: Warren Buffett Said “A Pin Lies in Wait for Every Bubble.” What He Did After the Last One Burst Is a Warning to Anyone Buying AI Stocks Now
items.summary: Warren Buffett wrote "a pin lies in wait for every bubble" in February 2001, with tech stocks already down 60%. He spent about $8 billion on brick, carpet, paint and insulation companies, left the fallen tech stocks alone, and found his bargain two years later in junk bonds. Here is what a 64-year-old with $480,000 in a tech fund can take from it.
